newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean defector still in Beijing-Seoul radio.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean defector still in Beijing-Seoul radio.

text.p: North Korea's top ideologue is still sheltering in South Korea's mission in Beijing because China and South Korea have yet to iron out minor details for his departure, state radio reported on Monday.

Korea Broadcasting System, quoting an unnamed senior government official, said in its 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) broadcast Hwang Jang-yop would leave China this week but possibly not on Monday or Tuesday. Officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
State radio quoted the official denying news reports Hwang had left Seoul's consulate in Beijing bound for the Philippines.
A Seoul foreign ministry official confirmed that Hwang, the most senior North Korean official to flee the troubled communist state, would leave for a third country before travelling to South Korea.
He declined to identify Hwang's likely first stop, saying an announcement would be made once Hwang arrived.
Earlier, state radio reported South Korea's ambassador to Beijing, Chung Chong-wook, bade Hwang farewell late on Sunday and the defector's departure might be as early as Monday.
